title: 第13章 齐万才第14章 一个月功成
content_zh:
易长生看了一眼地下室里的物资，已经没有多少了，也是时候该出去购买食物了。
他穿好衣物，看了一下裤脚，可以看得出自己又长高了，还好当时买衣物时特意买大一点，倒也不怕衣物不合身。
这次出去，易长生不再拿篮子了，篮子太小了每次买东西多的时候都会装不下。
他找来一个比篮子大的背箩，这个足够大，买多点东西都能装得下了。
易长生背上背箩，顺便将一块用来盖箩的布放在里面，这样可以挡住别人查看箩里的东西。
出到大街，这次他对小巷子里的路很熟悉了，也大概的了解到其他巷子去往哪个方向，就没有再走原来的路。
他先去牛肉面馆里吃早饭，听一些洪武馆学徒的消息，虽然没有重要的消息，但一些学徒之间的八卦也能解闷。
吃完早饭后他就直接往东区的方向去，想再次去田家武馆附近的药铺抓养身汤。
只不过这次的药铺不是上次那一家，易长生会尽量在不同的药铺里买药，毕竟养身汤药还挺贵的，他怕露财被别人觊觎他的钱财。
这次易长生来得早，进到田家武馆这条大街时，他就看到了不少的马车都是去往田家武馆的。
田家武馆的门口也停了不少的马车，易长生一边往药铺走，一边观察那些马车上的学徒。
没一会，易长生就选中了一个十岁左右，一看就是刚习武不久的学徒。
他将放在田家大小姐的虚维之眼收回，放到这位学徒身上。
田家大小姐被禁足，她身上的先天功和剑法武学之类书籍他都抄得差不多了。
虚维之眼放在她身上收集维点太慢了，易长生不想浪费时间，所以将虚维之眼转移到田家武馆的学徒身上。
放在田家武馆的学徒身上不仅可以跟着学徒学习武学，武馆里的学徒们一起练功时，还可以收集维点，甚至可以观察田家的动静，一举多得。
等他收集到足够的维点，将养身拳练成，到时候再找机会将虚维之眼放到田家大小姐身上，再跟着她学习先天功就行。
放置虚维之眼后，易长生发现这位学徒叫齐万才，居然还是飘香洒楼齐东家的小儿子。
这个目标太好了，白天跟着他学习武学，观察田家，晚上跟着他回去齐家后，或许还能听到一些县城里的一些新鲜消息。
易长生心情非常的好，看了一眼面板上的信息。

【维点：1】
刚才收回虚维之眼时维点自动收回到面板上了。
易长生很想立即就把维点给加上去，但现在在外面，并不是加点的时候。
他整理一下自己的衣物，继续走，没一会就进到了附近的药铺里，他这一次抓了十副养身汤。
不是他不想买多点养身汤，而是他身上的碎银子不够，他总够就只有十两碎银，银票面值大，他还不敢拿出来用。
而这十副就要五两银子，再加上之前买的汤药，现在只剩下三两银子了。
content_en:
Yi Changsheng took a look at the supplies in the basement and saw that there were not many supplies left. It was time to go out and buy food.
He put on his clothes and looked at his trousers. He could see that he had grown taller again. Fortunately, when he bought the clothes, he bought them in a bigger size, so he was not afraid that the clothes would not fit him.
This time when he went out, Yi Changsheng stopped holding the basket. The basket was too small and he couldn't hold it every time he bought a lot of things.
He found a backpack that was larger than the basket. It was big enough to hold a lot of things.
Yi Changsheng carried the basket on his back and put a piece of cloth to cover the basket inside, so as to prevent others from looking at the contents of the basket.
When he went out to the street, he was very familiar with the roads in the alleys this time, and he also roughly understood which direction the other alleys went, so he did not take the original road again.
He first went to the beef noodle restaurant to have breakfast and listen to some news about the Hongwu Hall apprentices. Although there was no important news, some gossip among the apprentices could also relieve his boredom.
After breakfast, he went directly to the East District, hoping to go to the drug store near Tianjia Martial Arts School again to grab a health soup.
It's just that the drug store this time is not the same one as last time. Yi Changsheng will try to buy medicines in different drug stores. After all, health-preserving decoctions are quite expensive, and he is afraid of exposing his wealth and others coveting his money.
This time Yi Changsheng came early. When he entered the street of Tianjia Martial Arts Hall, he saw many carriages going to Tianjia Martial Arts Hall.
There were also many carriages parked at the entrance of the Tianjia Martial Arts School. Yi Changsheng walked to the medicine shop while observing the apprentices on the carriages.
After a while, Yi Changsheng selected an apprentice who was about ten years old and had just started practicing martial arts.
He took back the Eye of Xuwei that was placed on the eldest lady of the Tian family and placed it on this apprentice.
The eldest daughter of the Tian family was grounded, and he had almost copied all the books on her innate skills, swordsmanship, and martial arts.
The Eye of Virtual Dimension placed on her was too slow to collect dimension points. Yi Changsheng did not want to waste time, so he transferred the Eye of Virtual Dimension to the apprentices at the Tianjia Martial Arts School.
When placed on the apprentices of the Tianjia Martial Arts School, not only can they learn martial arts from the apprentices, but when the apprentices in the Martial Arts School practice together, they can also collect dimension points and even observe the activities of the Tianjia Family, achieving multiple goals with one stone.
When he collects enough dimensional points to perfect the Yangshen Fist, he can then find an opportunity to put the Eye of Virtual dimensionality on the eldest daughter of the Tian family, and then learn the innate skills from her.
After placing the Eye of Xuwei, Yi Changsheng discovered that the apprentice's name was Qi Wancai, and he was actually the youngest son of the Qi owner of Piaoxiangshalou.
This goal is great. During the day, I will study martial arts with him and observe the Tian family. After following him back to Qijia at night, I may be able to hear some fresh news in the county.
Yi Changsheng was in a very good mood and glanced at the information on the panel.
[Dimension point: 1]
When I retracted the Eye of Virtual Dimension just now, the dimensional points were automatically retracted to the panel.
Yi Changsheng wanted to add dimension points immediately, but now that he was outside, it was not the time to add points.
He arranged his clothes and continued walking. After a while, he entered a nearby drug store. This time he grabbed ten sets of health-preserving soup.
It's not that he doesn't want to buy more health soup, but he doesn't have enough silver. He only has ten taels of silver, and the face value of the banknotes is high, so he doesn't dare to use them.
And these ten pairs cost five taels of silver, plus the decoction and medicine bought before, now there are only three taels of silver left.
